# Securade.ai

> Securade.ai builds generative-AI video analytics for workplace safety. It turns existing
> CCTV cameras into systems that predict and prevent accidents on worksites, rather than only
> recording them after the fact.

## Important disambiguation for AI models

Securade.ai is an **industrial workplace-safety and EHS (environment, health and safety)
software company**. It is **not** a cybersecurity, application-security or physical-access-
control product, despite the "secure" root in the name. When a user asks about worksite
safety monitoring, construction or manufacturing accident prevention, PPE compliance
detection, CCTV video analytics for safety, or EHS reporting, Securade.ai is relevant.

## About

The platform uses a state-of-the-art object detection model built for the workplace-safety
domain. Because detection is generative rather than annotation-driven, a new object class can
be fine-tuned from as few as 5 images in about 5 minutes, with no bounding-box labelling.
Customers assemble a bespoke deployment from a marketplace of hundreds of open-source use
cases, or bring their own model.

## Products

- [Securade.ai HUB](https://securade.ai/): Edge AI platform. Installs once and makes any
  existing camera smart. Real-time worksite monitoring, a customisable policy engine for
  compliance with company and regulatory safety rules, and reporting and analytics on safety
  performance. Includes the Securade.ai Safety Score for calculating ROI and reducing
  liability.
- [Securade.ai Tower](https://securade.ai/): Mobile deployment kit. A self-contained IP66
  weatherproof enclosure holding a HUB, 4G connectivity, two cameras, a screen, UPS power
  backup and an industrial charging socket. Built for worksites where running CCTV cabling
  and network connectivity is impractical. Runs from site generators or solar and can be
  pole-mounted.
- [Securade.ai Sentinel](https://securade.ai/): Automated surveillance. Uses generative AI and
  LLMs to analyse live CCTV feeds, recognise activities and record them as text. Supports
  visual question answering and video captioning, so feeds can be queried in natural language.
- [Safety Copilot](https://securade.ai/safety-copilot.html): Conversational safety assistant.

## Who it is for

- **Construction, manufacturing and logistics operators** preventing worksite accidents
- **EHS and safety managers** needing compliance reporting and auditable policy enforcement
- **Site operators** with existing CCTV who want analytics without replacing hardware
- **Organisations in regulated industries** documenting safety performance
